scope: deterministic categorical representation checks on fixed snapshots and site histories

fixtures: two persistent motifs and fresh nuisance labels, using the existing anchored permutation fixture
globally unique labels in five frames, with no eligible training motif and unseen test labels
cli_panel.anchor: anchored mode on the persistent fixture only, starting at site 8 with width 6
cli_panel.acceptance: exact CSV equality for every mode and relabeling, including statuses, costs and every permutation draw

model_panel.acceptance: the patterns change by the prescribed bijection in the same entry order, and model length, placement coordinates and test bit costs agree exactly where exposed

limits: label bijections only, with identical site and frame order; byte-level diagnostics and cross-representation comparisons are outside this panel
